prompt: Apply BBL typography to a hero section. The main title should be D1-medium and the sub-header H3-medium. Ensure the line-heights are correct for both English and Thai scripts as per the BBL design system.

assertions.text: hero.css is created and applies D1-medium typography to the main title for mobile.
hero.css applies D1-medium typography to the main title for desktop.
hero.css applies H3-medium typography to the sub-header for mobile.
hero.css applies H3-medium typography to the sub-header for desktop.
hero.css includes both English and Thai line-heights where applicable (e.g., using a custom property or direct value for each script if needed).
